retention: This file is a reviewed current snapshot. Dated reports under docs/self-improvement preserve prior observations.

changes.summary: Ruflo 3.42.4 corrects smart-memory search score semantics and adds upstream regression coverage; its documented reasoning-bank and vector-backend bridge limitation remains open.

Separates raw retrieval relevance from the SmartRetrieval RRF ranking score, preserving threshold evaluation before RRF, MMR and recency transformations; this does not resolve the documented reasoning-bank or vector-backend bridge fallback.
Refreshes generated NAPI-RS binaries across supported target platforms; no performance claim is inferred from the artifact update.
Fixes publish-blocking MinCut crate version pins and adds generated Node and web WASM package artifacts.
Adds an optional MinCut WASM wrapper with exact TypeScript fallback plus dynamic cut and directed road-routing capabilities when the reviewed WASM package is available.
Stops treating RVF as a VectorDB-compatible backend and makes the last-resort stub refuse writes instead of returning identifiers for discarded data.
Ruflo 3.42.3 groups quote-aware hook parsing and Windows publish-path fixes verified upstream on a real Windows machine.
Spawns npm.cmd through the Windows shell in the root publish preparation path, matching the platform execution contract.
Uses quote-aware parsing for the test-only hook CLI override so Windows executable paths containing spaces remain one argument.
Uses UUID-scoped MCP policy audit paths to prevent parallel tests from colliding on the same timestamp-derived file.
Passes the configured learning mode as the string expected by NeuralLearningSystem instead of an incompatible object shape.
Updates locked Hono and fast-uri dependencies to versions identified upstream as CVE fixes.
Fixes an HNSW search path that could silently omit stored points and adds recall, structural and issue-specific regression tests.
Raises the RVF dependency floor from 0.1.0 to 0.3.4 to avoid the string-identifier data-loss path documented by the upstream change.
Adds exact min-cut, routing and RuField spatial-awareness work across Rust, Node and WASM with real-data and regression workflows.
Ruflo 3.42.1 groups SONA environment defaults, reviewed reliability fixes and an agent-browser dependency update; constituent claims remain upstream evidence.
Opens the graph database with explicit options and refuses a volatile handle where persistence was requested.
Makes the configured witness Ed25519 root resolve the installed noble Ed25519 dependency on the exercised path.
Reads the untrusted-relay envelope emitted by the federation gateway and retains explicit untrusted-data handling in tests.
Adds diagnostic handling and fixtures for ADR-322C receipt-number violations in radio-MoE exports.
Changes radio-MoE streaming relevance scoring to an incremental path and publishes its benchmark artifact and reference tests.
Ruflo 3.42.0 groups 14 regression-tested swarm, memory, security, learning, topology and claim-correction changes; the release evidence is upstream-reported and not independently reproduced here.
Separated learned pattern reliability from query similarity so retrieval does not overwrite the confidence value used by trust gates.
Bound hive-mind join, leave and voting operations to minted capability tokens and roster membership to block fabricated Sybil voters.
Cached MMR token sets instead of re-tokenizing candidates; Ruflo reports byte-identical results and an approximately sixfold benchmark speedup.
Extended memory deduplication from byte identity to embedding-backed near-duplicate detection.
Changed memory consolidation from a fixed completion reward to outcome-specific confidence weighting.
Wired an opt-in MCP governance policy into the running server; enforcement remains off unless RUFLO_MCP_ENFORCE_POLICY is enabled.
Applied reliability and recency weights during reciprocal-rank fusion while retaining bounded score contribution.
Connected product-quantized HNSW data to the search dispatch path; the release reports more than double recall in its benchmark.
Propagated computed agent trust weights into Raft, Byzantine and gossip vote counting rather than discarding them.
Marks degraded retrieval fallback results explicitly so callers can distinguish them from the preferred path.
Ruflo 0.7.2 publishes a ChatGPT review MCP profile at /chatgpt/mcp, keeps the legacy /mcp surface, and marks irreversible relay sends as destructive hints.
Federation tools now declare destructive behavior accurately and relay text is labeled as untrusted input.
Published draft specifications and verification vectors for ANS, NIP-98 HTTP authentication, signed messages and protocol governance.
Aligned threat-model and MCP scan detection through an evaluated adversarial change.
Rejected min-cut-gated forgetting after evaluation; the negative result is retained as design evidence.
Governed embedding identity and MetaHarness promotion for persistent memory.
